q1: Do I need to top up?
a1: No. You pay for a plan for the period you choose, or monthly by auto-pay.
q2: Where do I get an activation code?
a2: In the device box, or from your seller if you bought the plan with the device.
q3: What happens when my paid period ends?
a3: We’ll remind you in advance. The SIM stays linked to your device — renew any time.
a4: Scan the SIM card’s QR code, or open the site and enter your email — we’ll send a code.
q5: My device isn’t connected. What should I do?
a5: Check the power. If it’s on and there’s been no connection for over an hour, call your seller.
